Error400.description: IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED: A task submission omitted Idempotency-Key. INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Invalid Playwright storage state or forbidden management control fields. INVALID_REQUEST: Malformed JSON, invalid field, ID, pagination or unknown setting.

Error401.description: UNAUTHORIZED: Missing, invalid, expired or revoked management bearer token.

Error403.description: CONSOLE_PASSWORD_REQUIRED: Key administration requires a fresh console-password session; model-key or old sessions do not qualify. FORBIDDEN: Authenticated key lacks a required scope.

Error404.description: NOT_FOUND: Resource or management route does not exist.

Error405.description: METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: Known management path does not support this method; no model fallback.

Error409.description: ACCOUNT_BUSY: Account did not drain within 60 seconds; no forced interruption without force:true. CANCELLED: Cooperative cancellation stopped uncommitted task work. DUPLICATE_ACCOUNT: Account email already exists; import never replaces existing credentials. IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: The same management key and Idempotency-Key were used with different canonical content. INTERRUPTED: Process restarted while the task was running; no automatic replay. INVALID_STATE: Requested transition is not valid in the current account/task state. VERSION_CONFLICT: Credential/state changed after verification began; stale commit rejected.

Error413.description: PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: Body exceeds 10 MiB, credentials exceed 1 MiB, or batch exceeds 100 items.

Error429.description: RATE_LIMITED: Management admission limit reached; retry later.

Error500.description: AUDIT_PERSISTENCE_FAILED: Operation committed but audit persistence failed. Read the resource/task state before retrying. INTERNAL_ERROR: Unexpected failure; message is redacted. PERSISTENCE_ERROR: Durable write failed; do not report a successful mutation. VERIFICATION_FAILED: Task item failed target-account verification; never fail over to another account. Async verification errors are reported in task/item.error; GET task still returns 200. VERIFICATION_TIMEOUT: Task item exceeded overall 10 minute verifier deadline. Async verification errors are reported in task/item.error; GET task still returns 200.

get.description: List safe account metadata; default limit 50, maximum 200.
Fetch account metadata using stable identity.

patch.description: Set enabled explicitly. Drain active work up to 60 seconds for disable; return ACCOUNT_BUSY if still active unless force:true.

post.description: Drain and archive while preserving account identity; cooperative cancellation does not roll back committed archive.

put.description: Verify an isolated candidate and replace only credentials. A versioned envelope rejects stale remote snapshots; legacy raw storageState remains compatible. Preserve newer manual flags. Do not expose candidate state in task/audit.

post.description: Reload account credentials/context after safe drain; production rebalance only after committed state.
Restore archived identity with disabled manual state; explicit enable is a separate action.
Default model mode uses gemini-3.8-flash. connection mode only proves connectivity. Isolated target only; no failover or production context mutation.
Process at most 100 target accounts; archive additionally requires accounts:archive. Drain up to 60 seconds; force explicitly permits interruption.
Return credentials only to an explicitly authorized exporter. Do not log the response.
Verify then commit and autoenable. Each clientRef is carried to its task item. Duplicate emails fail explicitly.

post.description: Request cooperative cancellation; response may still be running until in-flight work reaches a cancellation point. Already committed work is not rolled back.

get.description: Paginated, redacted usage records with target-account attribution.

delete.description: Revoke key immediately; cancel queued writes. Running work remains attributed to the creating key. Requires X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest. Origin, when supplied, must match scheme and host; Sec-Fetch-Site cross-site/same-site is rejected.
